origins.section: 6.1 A Missing Field Reads as `null`, and a Participant That Throws Answers Nobody
6.2 A Numeric Field Is Text That Nobody Checked
6.3 An Amount Counts the Minor Units of the Currency in Field 49
6.5 `set` Checks Nothing; the Packager Checks After the Vote

gates.says: all 4 of this quiz's answerable readings held and each was taken over the question as it stands

recorded.prompt:q-missing-entry-mode: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-missing-entry-mode: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-missing-entry-mode: 6.1 decides c: 'getString returns null for a field the message doesn't have', the exception escapes because 'The catch is for ISOException', the TransactionManager 'counts it as an ABORTED vote', and 'the participant never put a response in the Context, so there was nothing to send' (shown as 'no answer after 10024 ms'); the page shows Long.parseLong(null) throwing, so Integer.parseInt(null) throwing is a short inference.
recorded.prompt:q-signed-amount: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-signed-amount: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-signed-amount: 6.2 decides a: the table gives Long.parseLong of '-00000002500' as -2500, and 'The second is approved, because -25.00 is within any limit' (NaiveLimit: 'PREPARED, 0210 39=00'); applying the same reading to -4000 against 30000 is direct.
recorded.prompt:q-won-and-dinar: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-won-and-dinar: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-won-and-dinar: 6.3 decides a by analogy plus arithmetic: the page shows that reading cents everywhere 'approves the 7,000,000-yen purchase, over ninety times the limit, and declines a 120-dinar purchase within it', and 'dividing by 100 is wrong by a factor of 100 or 10'; the stem gives the won's and the KWD's decimals, and 30,000 <= 1,000,000 and 3,500 > 400 are the reader's own arithmetic.
recorded.prompt:q-long-reason-text: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-long-reason-text: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-long-reason-text: 6.5 says set stores any length, the packager checks only when SendResponse sends, the channel logs a <send> with the exception under it and 'not one byte went out', and that the same goes for 'a reason text from a database'; but 6.5's example sends in commit after a PREPARED vote, so applying it to the abort path (ABORTED vote, field 44) is an inference.

gates.says: all 12 of this quiz's discriminating readings held and each was taken over the question as it stands

recorded.prompt:q-missing-entry-mode:a: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-missing-entry-mode:a: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-missing-entry-mode:a: Refuted: the TransactionManager 'catches anything a participant throws, logs it as a warning and counts it as an ABORTED vote'. It builds no response, and the terminal gets 'no answer'.
recorded.prompt:q-missing-entry-mode:b: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-missing-entry-mode:b: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-missing-entry-mode:b: Refuted: 'The abort path called SendResponse, but the participant never put a response in the Context, so there was nothing to send', and the output shows no answer, not a 96.
recorded.prompt:q-missing-entry-mode:d: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-missing-entry-mode:d: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-missing-entry-mode:d: Refuted: the TransactionManager 'catches anything a participant throws', and the log shows the abort path running on (prepareForAbort: SendResponse, then abort for each participant), so the session does not stop.
recorded.prompt:q-signed-amount:b: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-signed-amount:b: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-signed-amount:b: Refuted: the table shows Long.parseLong returning -2500 for '-00000002500' and 2500 for '+00000002500', so it accepts a sign.
recorded.prompt:q-signed-amount:c: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-signed-amount:c: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-signed-amount:c: Refuted: 'Neither packager complained about any of these: the ASCII numeric field packager checks the length and pads with zeros, but doesn't look at the characters.'
recorded.prompt:q-signed-amount:d: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-signed-amount:d: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-signed-amount:d: Refuted: the table is 'what the server receives when a client puts other text in it, with iso87ascii.xml at both ends', and 'Neither packager complained'.
recorded.prompt:q-won-and-dinar:b: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-won-and-dinar:b: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-won-and-dinar:b: Refuted: the page shows the cents reading taking 000007000000 yen as '70000.00 -> 00' and 000000120000 dinars as '1200.00 -> 61', so a divide-by-100 participant does not see the real amounts (the real amounts are in the ISOCurrency column).
recorded.prompt:q-won-and-dinar:c: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-won-and-dinar:c: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-won-and-dinar:c: Refuted: the cents reading 'declines a 120-dinar purchase within it' (1200.00 -> 61), so dividing by 100 makes a three-decimal amount larger.
recorded.prompt:q-won-and-dinar:d: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-won-and-dinar:d: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-won-and-dinar:d: Refuted: the cents reading 'approves the 7,000,000-yen purchase' (70000.00 -> 00), so dividing by 100 makes a no-minor-unit amount smaller.
recorded.prompt:q-long-reason-text:a: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-long-reason-text:a: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-long-reason-text:a: 6.5 shows the packager refusing the value ('Field length 8 too long. Max: 6') and never shortening it, and warns 'Don't truncate'.
recorded.prompt:q-long-reason-text:b: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-long-reason-text:b: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-long-reason-text:b: 6.5 says the pack failed and 'not one byte went out' (the terminal got no answer), which refutes the option; the page never states outright that a field is not simply left out, so this is inferred from the example.
recorded.prompt:q-long-reason-text:d: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-long-reason-text:d: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-long-reason-text:d: 6.5's heading and text say set checks nothing: an ISOMsg 'knows nothing about lengths', so set stored the over-long value.
